info.name: Meridian Platform API - v1 Scenario Collection
info.description:
JWT/RBAC Postman companion for the Meridian HTTP API v1 contract.

Recommended run order:
1. Optionally run Customer Registration and Email Verification. Registration generates a fresh fictional email. Copy the raw token manually from local Mailpit into emailVerificationToken before running confirmation; no token is stored in the collection.
2. Run the Auth folder to capture role-specific Bearer tokens.
3. Run Paper Origination CP2 and CP3 to exercise Staff-assisted UCL and Collateral intake, atomic conversion, completed-case reconciliation, and initial checklist upload; choose fictional local PDFs for paperIntakeEvidenceFile and assistedApplicationEvidenceFile.
4. Run Public and Partner Admin requests.
5. Run Customer Profile and Bank Accounts, then Customer Employee Verification, then Salary Advance Application.
6. Run Loan Officer Review, Recommendation, Approval Decision, and Customer Approved Offer.
7. For UCL, prepare and accept the required evidence, enable uclOfferScenarioEnabled, then run the UCL verification-through-offer requests in order. Separate prepared fixture variables enable FAILED, REQUIRES_MORE_INFORMATION, correction/re-verification, cancellation, and outstanding-debt examples.
8. For Collateral Loan, originate the application, use the returned ownership checklist item with the common upload/review/completion requests, enable collateralVerificationScenarioEnabled, then run the lifecycle sequence through approval, exact offer and contract assertions, Customer acknowledgment, readiness, destination reveal, activation, replay, final schedule, partial repayment, history, exact settlement, and closure. Separate prepared fixture variables exercise the other Approver and offer-terminal outcomes.

The Salary Advance, UCL, and Collateral happy paths are duplicate-sensitive because the authenticated demo customer can have only one active application per product. Run them on a fresh local database, or reset test data before repeating a full happy-path flow.

item.description: Run this folder in order after Auth and after a Salary Advance has reached DISBURSED with an ACTIVE LoanAccount. Scenarios 2-4 depend on scenario 1: exact replay reuses its request UUID and logical content; request-key reuse keeps that UUID but changes the reference; duplicate-reference uses a fresh request UUID with a canonically equivalent reference. Scenario 1 initializes fresh fictional request UUIDs and payment references for the entire run, so rerunning the folder against the same database creates a new initial repayment rather than an accidental replay. Scenarios 7-10 read the committed result using Customer/staff ownership rules. Scenario 11 requires a deliberately established OVERDUE fixture: run the UTC overdue evaluator after an installment due date, then run scenario 10 to capture a positive overdueCureAmount. If no overdue amount is present, scenario 11 is skipped and never sends zero. Scenarios 12-14 depend on the current outstanding amount captured by scenarios 1, 10, and optionally 11. Tokens, loanApplicationId, and normal Salary Advance submission prerequisites must already be present; scripts capture only non-sensitive run identities and derived amounts and never print them.

The sequence proves purpose-specific settlement and closure discovery, exact product filtering, server-owned membership, restricted-field exclusion, immutable settlement recovery evidence, pre-settlement closure rejection, permission boundaries, stale amount rejection, exact settlement and replay, post-settlement rejection, closure and replay, different-request rejection, and safe response fields.
